included: docs/BCI Report Benchmark Expansion Results and Publication Handoff.md
Audited Gal4 outputs referenced by the aggregate bundle, including completed single-band ensemble TRCA

findings.discrepancy: The wearable interpretation limit says, without a track qualifier, that calibration budget 0 uses a source-only model and budgets 12/24/48 use target-only models. That is true only for the spectral-ridge wearable-calibration track. In wearable-etrca-calibration, budget 0 is label-free analytic CCA and budgets 24/48 are target-only ensemble TRCA; there is no 12-label TRCA condition.

evidence.aggregate_limit: Calibration budget0 uses a source-only model; budgets12/24/48 use target-only models. Do not draw them as one continuous model-update curve.

findings.publication_risk: A publisher could incorrectly present the common-test CCA row as a source-trained zero-budget point or merge the two calibration tracks into one adaptation curve.
findings.required_correction: Qualify the existing sentence as applying to wearable-calibration/spectral ridge, and add a separate sentence stating that wearable-etrca-calibration uses analytic CCA at zero labels and target-only eTRCA at 24/48 labels. Preserve the warning that the two tracks are not one continuous model-update curve.
findings.resolution_evidence: The regenerated wearable interpretation limit now names wearable-calibration and wearable-etrca-calibration separately, identifies zero-label eTRCA-track CCA as an analytic reference, and limits the continuous-curve warning to the spectral-ridge track.

findings.discrepancy: All six eTRCA aggregate rows and the method reference use model=ensemble-trca, while the six paired contrasts use model=etrca.
findings.publication_risk: A consumer joining contrasts to model metadata by exact identifier can orphan or split the eTRCA contrasts.
findings.required_correction: Use model=ensemble-trca for the paired contrasts, or add a canonical model identifier and an explicit display alias consistently across rows, contrasts, and method references.
findings.resolution_evidence: All six regenerated wearable-etrca-calibration paired contrasts now use model=ensemble-trca, matching the eTRCA rows and method reference.

findings.discrepancy: The generator records the eTRCA independent-audit digest and asserts results.status=complete_audited, but it does not read independent-audit.json and assert status=PASS before exporting the rows. Other completed tracks directly check an audit status or an audited result status with an explicit audit read.
findings.publication_risk: There is no error in the present bundle, but a future failed or stale eTRCA audit would not stop regeneration if results.json still claimed complete_audited.
findings.required_correction: Read the eTRCA independent audit and assert its status is PASS before adding rows and contrasts.
findings.resolution_evidence: The generator now reads wearable-trca-20260920/output/independent-audit.json and asserts status=PASS before exporting eTRCA rows. The current independent audit remains PASS with SHA-256 718dff16d6037cbf936f7962b31cdd0f45e0cb2f453453dae0450e5249c5ffa8.

resolution_recheck.scope: Only AHIR-001 through AHIR-003 and the regenerated-bundle identity were rechecked; the pending seed-summary section remains excluded.
checks: The regenerated bundle remains at 82 rows and 18 paired contrasts.
The calibration interpretation text is now track-specific and distinguishes source-only spectral ridge from analytic CCA.
All eTRCA paired contrasts use the canonical ensemble-trca identifier.
The generator asserts eTRCA independent-audit status PASS before export.
The generator additionally asserts the wearable CPU and neural scientific-audit statuses.
Aggregate output replacement is atomic through a same-directory temporary file followed by Path.replace.

numbers: All 82 row values and their confidence intervals exactly match their allowlisted source fields.
All 18 paired differences and paired confidence intervals exactly match the audited source artifacts.
All rounded tables and contrasts in the handoff markdown agree with the aggregate JSON, including the corrected full-precision two-second Mobile SSVEP values and completed eTRCA values.
channels_and_windows: Wearable rows use the native eight channels and two-second window.
Mobile SSVEP scalp rows use eight selected posterior channels from 32 recorded channels; ear five-second rows use 14 contacts.
Mobile SSVEP two-second rows use the same eight selected scalp channels and [0,2 s) window for CCA, spectral ridge, LaBraM, and CBraMod.
Mobile ERP rows use 32 scalp channels or 14 ear contacts and preserve the physical-time feature and baseline windows.
sample_counts: Wearable transfer rows: 102 participants and 12,240 target-sensor trials per condition.
Wearable common-test calibration rows: 102 participants and 7,344 trials per sensor/condition.
Mobile SSVEP: 23 participants, 1,380 trials per movement condition, 4,140 unique trials across the three conditions.
Mobile ERP: 7,100 trials for each 24-participant standing/walking condition and 4,800 trials for each 17-participant running condition.
eTRCA audit: 408 fitted target-only heads and 44,064 prediction rows.
metrics_and_units: Aggregate values are proportions; the markdown correctly renders balanced accuracy as percent and differences as percentage points.
Mobile ERP remains participant-mean ROC AUC and is not relabeled as accuracy.
Wearable physical amplitude remains undocumented; no microvolt assumption is made, and common-scalar unit conversion is kept distinct from wet/dry hardware-domain shift.
Mobile SSVEP scalp/ear microvolt evidence and the 100 Hz versus 500 Hz ERP conversion sensitivity are represented consistently with the audited protocols.
primary_and_sensitivity_handling: Source-independent wearable CCA, FBCCA, random, and same-frequency references are deduplicated across display-only source labels and have source_sensor=null.
Mobile CCA rows are labeled analytic references; supervised ridge and frozen-encoder rows are labeled as standing-other-participants training.
Fixed alpha-100 pretraining attribution and inner-training selected-head sensitivity remain separate tracks; the handoff instructs publishers to show both and not select the better test score.
The superseded scale-sensitive wearable log1p ridge is not exported as primary.
The paired common-17 ERP contrast is identified as a secondary descriptive analysis.
privacy: The aggregate JSON contains no participant IDs, participant-level arrays, demographics, raw signals, fitted heads, predictions, y_true/y_pred fields, or private absolute filesystem paths.
The JSON's dataset-author names and participant-metadata field names are citation and exclusion metadata, not participant records.
The markdown's Gal4 locations are explicitly marked private infrastructure and are not present in the public candidate JSON.
provenance: All 15 evidence digests in the current aggregate JSON match the current referenced files.
The aggregate dataset/version citations and raw-redistribution exclusions agree with the separate publication-readiness review.

review_method: Recomputed an exact source-to-export mapping for every populated track and compared values, confidence intervals, participant counts, trial counts, models, sensors/modalities, conditions, and speeds.
Compared every paired contrast to the corresponding audited source field.
Checked the markdown's displayed rounded values and reported row/contrast counts against the aggregate JSON.
Recomputed every evidence-file SHA-256 referenced by the bundle.
Recursively scanned aggregate keys and values for participant-level payloads and private filesystem paths.
Inspected frozen protocols and independent audits for channel selection, windows, physical units, split semantics, and completed eTRCA counts.
